items.content: There was no possibility of taking a walk that day. We had been wandering, indeed, in the leafless shrubbery an hour in the morning; but since dinner the cold winter wind had brought with it clouds so sombre, and a rain so penetrating, that further out-door exercise was now out of the question.
items.explanation: Jane Eyre's opening, 1847. The precision of weather detail and the subordinate clauses stacked to defer the main point are characteristics of Victorian prose that AI tends to simplify.

items.content: The sun, in its final concession to the horizon, gilded the rooftops in a amber that seemed almost reluctant to fade — as though light itself understood what it meant to leave. The water towers and corniced ledges caught what the streets below had already lost, holding it a moment longer, the way certain people hold the end of a conversation. Then, almost without announcement, it was gone, and the buildings became simply buildings again, grey and indifferent, belonging now to the evening.

items.content: The rain arrived sometime past midnight, tapping first at the fly sheet with a tentative politeness before settling into its steady, democratic drumming against every surface at once. Inside, zipped into the warm animal dark of a sleeping bag, she lay still and listened, feeling the sound fold around her like a second shelter. There was something ancient in it — the particular comfort of being small and enclosed while something vast and indifferent moved overhead. She did not sleep so much as dissolve slowly into the noise.

items.content: He sat hunched over his coffee like a man guarding a secret, the mug long cold, the spoon resting at an angle that suggested defeat. Around him the diner exhaled — chairs lifted onto tables, the grill gone quiet, fluorescent light flickering above the pie case like something losing its will to continue. The waitress moved through the room with the careful patience of someone who had learned not to ask. Outside, the street held nothing he was ready for.
